snippet.title: We Have To Let You Go (Release Date Trailer)
snippet.description:
We Have To Let You Go is a retro inspired RPG that combines turn-based battling and environmental puzzles. The game will release July 25th!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111650/We_Have_To_Let_You_Go/?beta=0
